json.description: Small bottom-right toast that appears after a scroll threshold and points visitors to a sample demo page. Dismissable; dismissal persists in localStorage so visitors don't see it twice.

id.description: Stable id used for the dismiss flag. Bump when the copy changes if you want everyone to see the new message.

heading.description: One-line headline. Keep under ~50 chars for readable wrapping at 340px width.

cta.href.description: CTA URL — typically the demo's home path.

scrollThreshold.description: Fraction of full document scroll before the toast appears. 0.3 = 30%.

minDelayMs.description: Minimum ms to wait after page load before showing (prevents flash on tall pages where 30% is at the fold).

dismissCooldownDays.description: Days before a dismissed toast reappears. 0 = permanent dismiss.

hideOnPaths.description: Paths to suppress on. Trailing '*' = prefix match.

showOnlyOnPaths.description: If set, only show on these paths.
